findings.summary: The interaction catch-up notice is hard-coded Traditional Chinese and appears in the English interface

F on an aimed ball makes it Fixed, but the expected hint 'The object is fixed; explicitly resume to continue the simulation.' is not shown; the automated run saw 'Authoring edit: paused and cleared previous sounds.'
The B key only switches to build mode and shows no placement preview; only the 'Switch to build' button starts a box preview
Acoustic geometry includes only boxes, so the default ball (acousticRole dynamicOccluder) never blocks a path; this limit is not stated in docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md
The WebGL-unavailable fallback inside the canvas has role=alert and is exposed to the accessibility tree while WebGL works; screen-reader behaviour not tested

In headless Chrome, recording paused for the fixed-step workload limit about every 0.1 s of simulated time (0.82 s recorded in 6.1 s wall time, also on an idle machine); consistent with the retained R17 performance FAIL, not representative of a GPU browser
